name: Broodlord Lashlayer
source: [logs: Anniversary] Melee 2,042 to 3,195 before armor under the bench's raid debuffs, a swing every 1.78 s on the tank: Warcraft Logs, 22 kills on the Anniversary Hardcore realms (Normal, 2025-03-31 to 2025-07-31): the median of 224 normal hits' unmitigatedAmount (2,590), the 5th to 95th percentile of each hit over its own kill's median (224 hits) stretched to an even roll, and the swings a second while he was on the main tank. Taken back through the debuffs the bench puts on him (attack power 805 to 601, -37 a swing, attack speed 0.833): 1,673 weapon damage, spread 0.689, a 1.48 s swing. Length: the kills' length, median 41 s (10th to 90th percentile 39 to 65). Weapon damage abilities: Mortal Strike 24573 10,500 to 16,190 from 25 hits; 18670 scaled with the melee (7 hits in the logs, too few); Cleave 15284 2,020 to 3,510 from 16 hits. Abilities: Mortal Strike 24573 (500% weapon damage and 50% less healing taken for 5 s), Knock Away 18670 (weapon damage + 30), Cleave 15284 (weapon damage + 10), Blast Wave 23331 2,625 to 3,375 Fire, from the Classic Era client's spell data. Timers from the vmangos script, which says they are probably wrong.
abilitiesSource: Mortal Strike 24573 (500% weapon damage and 50% less healing taken for 5 s), Knock Away 18670 (weapon damage + 30), Cleave 15284 (weapon damage + 10), Blast Wave 23331 2,625 to 3,375 Fire, from the Classic Era client's spell data. Timers from the vmangos script, which says they are probably wrong.
notes: Knock Away's 50% threat cut isn't modelled. Blast Wave hits everyone near him, here the tanks only, and the healing sim adds the melee.

healing.notes: From the Anniversary Hardcore realms's logs (22 kills): while the boss was on the main tank, 8 healers had 5% or more of its healing (the median kill), and the healing it took from others was 2,404 a second with overheal and absorbs (24% of the heals effective), 2.64 heals and HoT ticks a second, against 637 damage taken a second. The tank's own heals (2% of its healing) are left out. Main tanks: Warrior 16, Druid 6.

raidHealing.notes: What the Anniversary Hardcore realms raids had on Broodlord Lashlayer (22 kills, Warcraft Logs): the median kill's raid of 40 with 4 tanks (2 of them on adds, who took 100 a second together, not in the events), 11 healers by Warcraft Logs' healer role (93% of the healing), each 439 HPS with overheal. The raid healed 2,071 a second (869 on the tanks, 1,109 on the rest, 49% overheal on the rest). Each non-tank took 29.0 a second after mitigation. Fight length is the 10th percentile, median and 90th percentile kill. For the healing sim to check its healer counts against.

raidSource: [logs: the Anniversary Hardcore realms] The raidDamage events with who NotTanks: Warcraft Logs, 22 kills (tools/warcraftlogs/wclcli.py raid, tools/encounters/logs/anniversary_bwl_raid.json): the abilities that dealt 2% or more of the non-tanks' damage taken in 10% or more of the kills, 100% of it together, their rates scaled by 1.00 for the rest. Each is a share of the non-tanks, so the file fits any raid size. Blast Wave 23331 from Broodlord Lashlayer (85% of the non-tanks' damage, in 19 of 22 kills): 2,641 to 3,373 unmitigated, the 5th to 95th percentile stretched to an even roll; 48% of the non-tanks a cast (10th to 90th percentile 38 to 56), 24.7 landed a second on each (100% of it landing), so a cast every 30.26 s at random (the logs count 1.5 casts a minute), the first at 21 s (median) of a 44 s kill. Melee 1 from Corrupted Bronze Whelp (11% of the non-tanks' damage, in 22 of 22 kills): 240 to 415 unmitigated, the 5th to 95th percentile stretched to an even roll; 3% of the non-tanks a cast (10th to 90th percentile 3 to 5), 3.0 landed a second on each (69% of it landing), so a cast every 1.93 s at random (the logs count 22.1 casts a minute), the first at 3 s (median) of a 44 s kill. Cleave 15754 from Broodlord Lashlayer (4% of the non-tanks' damage, in 18 of 22 kills): 2,283 to 3,658 unmitigated, the 5th to 95th percentile stretched to an even roll; 3% of the non-tanks a cast (10th to 90th percentile 3 to 5), 1.2 landed a second on each (47% of it landing), so a cast every 19.42 s at random (the logs count 1.9 casts a minute), the first at 17 s (median) of a 44 s kill. Together they land 29.0 a second on each non-tank over a median kill, at the logs' mitigation, against 29.0 in the logs.
